query_text:
Hello Hauler Alpha,

When comparing this year's invoices with our contract, we found lines that differ from the agreed terms, about €269.35 above them in total, and €67.17 of overflow charges on pickups that came late. The largest are below.

- 2026-07-16, Lohja site 4, mixed waste: Pickup fee: invoice €125.54, contract €0.00; Transport: invoice €41.54, contract €0.00. No pickup with job reference OP-A-P260728481.
- 2026-01-05, Helsinki site 2, plastic film: Pickup 87 h after the order. Overflow charges: €67.17.
- 2026-09-24, Helsinki site 2, plastic film: Transport: invoice €79.36, contract €39.68.
- 2025-12-01, Lohja site 4, cardboard: Material credit: invoice −€203.05, contract −€238.89.
- 2025-12-01, Helsinki site 2, cardboard: Material credit: invoice −€59.87, contract −€70.44.
- 2025-10-14, Helsinki site 2, cardboard: Fuel surcharge: invoice €18.40, contract €9.20.
- 2026-04-22, Lohja site 4, cardboard: Material credit: invoice −€39.56, contract −€46.54.

There may be a good reason, such as a reschedule or an access problem. Could you check these and let us know? Thank you.

explain.text: Hauler Epsilon and Hauler Beta are lowest at €19,518 a year. Hauler Alpha has the best on-time record, 69 %.
